description: DUT discards a TCP packet with Checksum = 0 and sends no ACK (RFC 793 §3.1)
approach:
[Objective]
Unlike UDP (where checksum=0 is a legal opt-out), TCP has no zero-checksum opt-out — checksum=0 is invalid. DUT must drop.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: data with TCP Checksum=0.
3. Observation: DUT must NOT ack.

[Pass condition]
No DUT ACK to zero-checksum.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_unexpected_ack — DUT acked zero-checksum

verdicts.Fail_unexpected_ack: DUT acked segment with zero checksum
